about: The revisions of the sources cited in normative.json, archived on 2026-09-27 by git clone of the WG repositories. The files are not committed; each is named by repository, tag or commit, path, size and SHA-256. The published RFC texts were NOT RETRIEVED (www.rfc-editor.org and www.ietf.org not reachable from the measuring environment).

sections.mapping_note: UNCERTAIN (heading). The source has no section numbers; 1.4 is computed as the fourth numbered subsection of 'Introduction'. Its heading in the source is 'CBOR Grammar'; the title used in the published RFC could not be checked and may differ (RFC Editor retitling). Content is the CDDL grammar conventions subsection. Revision caveat above applies.
Computed draft number 3, heading 'Header Parameters'. Range includes subsection 3.1. Not checked against the published RFC. Revision caveat above applies.

Computed draft number 3.1, heading 'Common COSE Header Parameters'. Corroborated: the RFC 9596 source (archived here, rfc9596/, section 2) cites 'Section 3.1 of RFC9052' for the content type header parameter, which this subsection defines. Revision caveat above applies.

Computed draft number 4.4, heading 'Signing and Verification Process' (anchor Sig_structure). Corroborated: the RFC 9995 source (line 172) cites 'Section 4.4 of RFC9052' for the to-be-signed structure, and the RFC 9943 source (line 800, alias -COSE = RFC9052) cites it for signature verification. Revision caveat above applies.
Computed draft number 9, heading 'CBOR Encoding Restrictions'. Not checked against the published RFC. Revision caveat above applies.

sources.notes: No version tag exists. The archived file is the last content state of the source on the master branch: commit 146df4015e97b916250c1ba052aecc8cffb0eeb0 (2021-01-30, merge of pull request #29) is the last mainline commit that changed the file; the file blob b2b22b3c84db86fc788feb539f4b6326a842be80 is unchanged through master HEAD 3fa9e3c34a3419cd40586a389f2a5d55bc8f8f1e (checked with git ls-remote at 2026-09-27T20:14:19Z). The file's docName attribute reads 'draft-ietf-cose-rfc8152bis-struct-13'; the repository did not record later version numbers, so which submitted version this file equals, and whether it is the last draft before RFC 9052, is UNCERTAIN (the datatracker, which would settle it, is not reachable).

sources.notes: https://github.com/cose-wg/draft-ietf-cose-cwt-claims-in-headers does not exist or is not public (git clone at 2026-09-27T20:07:38Z failed: authentication requested). Also probed without success: cose-wg/cwt-claims-in-headers, cose-wg/draft-ietf-cose-cwt-claims-in-header, cose-wg/cose-cwt-claims-in-headers, tplooker/cwt-claims-in-headers.
